notes.title: Update 1.8
notes.content:
This update was supposed to be released a month ago for the game's two-year anniversary, but I had to postpone it. However, now it is ready.

What is special about this update? A significant simplification of the level of complexity. The balance of resources and tasks has been reworked at the most difficult levels of the game:
1. The number of rations has increased, at some levels twofold;
2. The number of targets has decreased.

I can understand that. It is a little unusual to see such an update two years after the release of the game, but in my defense, I initially saw this game exclusively hardcore - release version of 2016 was already greatly simplified, but it was not enough. So far, I've been getting requests from a lot of people who are asking for a reduction in difficulty, since they can't really enjoy the story, and the hardcore only gets in the way. In this regard, I finally gathered my thoughts and returned to the source files. A lot of time was spent trying to understand the insides of the game, but I figured it out and eventually made an update. I hope this time you will be able to complete the game without any problems.

Thank you for attention.

notes.title: The update with easy mode is now available!
notes.content:
The new update has fixed minor bugs and added a new Lite mode.
This mode allows you to enable and disable the randomized difficulty - if you have to rely on luck, you now have to learn to "shoot" literally, because with the inclusion of this mode, success will depend on your efforts.
